svg.title: RepoChronos complete Chen ER atlas
svg.desc: Read left to right, then down. All 15 domain entities, all stored attributes and 19 declared foreign-key relationships. Repeated entity names refer to the same entity.

text.tspan: 15 entities, 19 declared foreign keys and every domain column
(0,N) = zero to many (1,1) = exactly one (0,1) = optional single
A double line marks total participation. Min/max labels sit beside their entity.
Underlined attributes form the primary key. UK = unique key. FK = foreign key.
Dashed ovals denote derived values. Each repeated entity name is the same entity.
Coverage: 14 repochronos tables + public.users. Framework sessions, cache and jobs are outside the domain model.
Parent entity on the left. Dependent entity on the right. Each lane maps one foreign key.
Relationships / repeated entities keep all connectors separate
Every commit belongs to exactly one repository.
A commit records one Git author, independent of app membership.
File paths are unique within their repository.
Each change belongs to one imported commit.
Parent entity on the left. Dependent entity on the right. Each lane maps one foreign key.
Relationships / repeated entities keep all connectors separate
The current file path of the change is mandatory.
Only changes with a prior path need this optional relationship.
A new engine can add a run. Repeating the same engine cannot duplicate it.
A run can have zero functions, including unsupported or empty source.
Parent entity on the left. Dependent entity on the right. Each lane maps one foreign key.
Relationships / repeated entities keep all connectors separate
One membership links exactly one user and one repository.
Role belongs to the membership, not globally to the user.
Every report belongs to exactly one repository.
*New reports require one user. Legacy records may have NULL.
Parent entity on the left. Dependent entity on the right. Each lane maps one foreign key.
Relationships / repeated entities keep all connectors separate
A newly reported bug may have no events yet.
*New events require one user. Legacy records may have NULL.
Exactly one developer for assigned events; NULL for progress and fixed.
Exactly one commit for fixed events; NULL for assigned and progress.
Parent entity on the left. Dependent entity on the right. Each lane maps one foreign key.
Relationships / repeated entities keep all connectors separate
A repository may have many imported pages across head SHAs.
The scan shares the change key. No scan means no legacy result.
Warning.change_id references Scan.change_id, not Change directly.
SOURCE BLOB has no declared FK relationship.
changes.blob_sha may be used to look up source_blobs.sha in application code.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
UK (source_key). Identity id. A repository may exist before any commits, files or bugs are imported.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
UK (identity_key). A Git author identity is independent of an application user account.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
UK (repo_id, sha). SHA must contain exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
UK (repo_id, path). A file record identifies a path inside a repository. Renames link two file records.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
UK (commit_id, file_id). additions >= 0 and deletions >= 0. The change_repo trigger enforces repository consistency.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
UK (change_id, engine). threshold > 0. status: analyzed, unsupported, removed or unavailable.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
UK (run_id, signature, line). line > 0 and score >= 1. Every valid result is stored, including low scores.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
public.users: UK (email). Laravel stores a password hash. User accounts and Git authors have no direct FK.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
Composite PK (repo_id, user_id). role: owner, editor or viewer. This association resolves User–Repository M:N.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
Trimmed title length: 1–160. reporter length: 1–80. New rows require reporter_user_id; old NULL rows are allowed.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
kind: assigned, progress or fixed. New rows require actor_user_id. A partial unique index permits one fix per bug.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
Composite PK (repo_id, head_sha, page). page > 0. A checkpoint belongs to one repository and one import head.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
Content cache keyed by SHA. changes.blob_sha is an application lookup, with no declared foreign key.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
Legacy analysis only. Shared PK/FK permits at most one scan per change. The Lizard workflow uses analysis_runs.
Attribute dictionary / keys underlined / FK roles shown on relationship sheets
Legacy warnings only. line > 0 and score >= 6. Current Lizard warnings derive from measurements and run thresholds.
Dashed ovals belong to report views. They are not extra stored columns.
Derived attributes / v_bug_current, v_measurement_history and v_complexity_trend
Current analysis warning = measurement.score > analysis_run.threshold. Trends group by repository, commit and engine.
Constraints that make the diagram meaningful
Relationship structure combines with SQL checks, indexes, triggers and application authorization.
change_repo ensures current and previous files share the commit repository.
assigned requires a developer. fixed requires a commit. progress requires neither.
validate_event locks the bug, rejects earlier events and prevents events after a fix.
An actor needs owner/editor access. An assignee must have committed to this repository.
An assignment must exist before progress or a fix. The fixing commit must belong to the same repository.
13 domain tables reject UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE. repository_members remains mutable.
Unique (change_id, engine) and (run_id, signature, line) preserve distinct analysis history.
